sens_en: to twist, to wring, to screw, stubborn
origine_fr: Pour s'en souvenir : à gauche, la main 扌 ; à droite, 宁, le calme, qui se lit níng, comme 拧. La main tord un linge jusqu'au calme de la dernière goutte. C'est tordre, essorer, visser.
origine_en: To remember it: on the left, the hand 扌; on the right, 宁, calm, read níng, like 拧. The hand wrings a cloth until the calm of the last drop. That is to twist, to wring, to screw.
